narrative: His roll for the afternoon, cues to the right of a rule, no speech copied out in his hand. The name of the part is not written at the head. He does not add it. He looks for a new instruction and does not write one. The red thread is on the Romeo bundle, not on this. He goes on with the strip as it is.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, and did not name the part on the strip.

entities.name: The Taming of the Shrew
entities.context: Shown on part in In it, and not named
